findings.title: Modified config copy is discarded; original unmodified config is returned
findings.body: In `get_monitor_environment_context`, lines 160-162 create a copy of `monitor_environment.monitor.config` and replace the `schedule_type` value with its human-readable display string. However, line 168 returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original, unmodified dict) instead of the local `config` variable that was modified. The result is that the `schedule_type` in the monitor context sent to Kafka will contain the raw enum value rather than the display string, and the copy + modification on lines 160-162 is dead code. This is a pre-existing bug carried over from `mark_failed.py`, but since this PR is reorganizing this code, it would be a good time to fix it by using `"config": config` on line 168.
